menorca.over_budget_rule: allow only if exceptional value / unusually strong deal
ranking_notes: Highest priority: 3+ bedroom farmhouse/country/rustic properties in or near Alaior or Es Mercadal at or below target budget.
Also high priority: 3+ bedroom apartments in the town centers of Alaior or Es Mercadal at or below target budget.
Elsewhere on Menorca: include only when pricing or property quality makes the listing unusually compelling.
Prefer new listings, meaningful price reductions, larger homes, usable outdoor space, and properties needing only manageable renovation.

priority_area.description: Cantabria coast and nearby inland areas, roughly San Vicente de la Barquera through Santander, Santoña/Laredo and Castro Urdiales.

northern_spain.broader_value_scan: Include exceptional deals elsewhere along the nearby northern coast if they fit the farmhouse/beach profile.
northern_spain.renovation_preference: Fixer-uppers are welcome when structure/location/price make the renovation worthwhile.
northern_spain.over_budget_rule: Allow only if exceptional value, unusually close to the coast, substantial land, or clearly under-market.
ranking_notes: Highest priority: 3+ bedroom farmhouse/country/stone house near the Cantabria coast at or below the target budget.
Strongly prefer properties within practical driving distance of a beach, even when slightly inland.
Fixer-uppers can rank highly when the purchase price leaves substantial room for renovation.
Boost land, stone construction, character, sea/coastal access, and meaningful price reductions.
Include standout bargains elsewhere along the nearby northern coast when they are unusually compelling.
